_about.what: Official results of Paris votations used as backtests, with question wording, rules, eligibility and polls.
_about.shares: yesShare / noShare are shares of EXPRESSED votes (Pour+Contre), as published by the City.
_about.sectors: 17 votation sectors: 'Paris Centre' (1er-4e merged) and '5e'..'20e'. districtCodes = INSEE codes.
_about.license: Ville de Paris open data (opendata.paris.fr); figures re-published with attribution.
_about.disclaimer: Simulation outputs compared with these numbers are hypotheses, not evidence of public opinion.

paris_scooters_2023.voteName: Votation du 2 avril 2023 — trottinettes en libre-service
paris_scooters_2023.titleEn: Paris citizens' vote on rental e-scooters
paris_scooters_2023.question: Pour ou contre les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris ?
paris_scooters_2023.questionAsProclaimed: « POUR ou CONTRE les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris ? »

ballotOptions.pour: Pour les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris
ballotOptions.contre: Contre les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris

paris_scooters_2023.yesMeaning: 'Pour' = keep allowing rental (self-service, free-floating) e-scooters on Paris streets, i.e. the City would renew or re-tender the public-space agreements with operators. 'Contre' = end them when the agreements expired on 31 August 2023.
paris_scooters_2023.legalStatus: Consultative 'consultation facultative ouverte' (Code des relations entre le public et l'administration L.131-1; CGCT L.1111-2). The Mayor said the City would 'purely and simply' follow the result.

eligibility.who: People registered on the Paris electoral lists by 3 March 2023 (midnight). EU nationals registered on the complementary electoral list for municipal elections were part of the electorate (règlement, art. 7). Young people turning 18 by 1 April 2023 and newly naturalised citizens could vote if INSEE had added them to the electoral register (art. 10).
eligibility.note: Voters living abroad and those registered under articles L.12-L.14 of the electoral code are attached to the 4e arrondissement list (règlement), which adds registrations to 'Paris Centre' and can lower its measured turnout.

sources.name: Règlement de la votation du 2 avril 2023 (PDF, scanned; art. 7, 10, 12, 13)
Rapport de la commission de contrôle, votation du 2 avril 2023 (PDF, 19 p.)

notes: Same day as the Paris Marathon; the control commission recommended avoiding such clashes in future.
The commission noted many complaints (often older or disabled people) that there was no proxy or remote vote.
The commission criticised the operators' campaign with paid influencers (report, p. 18).
Operators offered a free ride on voting day (AFP), a tactic the press called controversial.

sources.name: Rapport de la commission de contrôle, votation du 2 avril 2023 (PDF, 19 p.)
Règlement de la votation du 2 avril 2023 (PDF, scanned; art. 7, 10, 12, 13)

rules.fleetCap: 3 operators, each allowed at most 5,000 vehicles (about 15,000 in total)
rules.scope: Rental (self-service) e-scooters only. Privately owned e-scooters were not concerned according to some press reports (not checked in a primary source).
rules.outcome: Rental e-scooters left Paris streets at the end of the agreements on 31 August 2023.

paris_suv_2024.voteName: Votation du 4 février 2024 — tarif de stationnement des voitures lourdes (« Plus ou moins de SUV à Paris ? »)
paris_suv_2024.titleEn: Paris citizens' vote on a parking fee for heavy cars (SUVs)
paris_suv_2024.question: Pour ou contre la création d'un tarif spécifique pour le stationnement des voitures individuelles lourdes, encombrantes, polluantes ?
paris_suv_2024.campaignTitle: Plus ou moins de SUV à Paris ?
paris_suv_2024.yesMeaning: 'Pour' = create the specific (tripled) visitor parking rate for heavy cars; 'Contre' = keep the normal rate for all cars.
paris_suv_2024.legalStatus: Consultative vote under the control of an independent control commission.

eligibility.who: People registered on the Paris electoral lists on 8 January 2024. EU nationals could vote only if registered on the complementary list for municipal elections.
eligibility.quote: « S'agissant des ressortissants communautaires, seuls ceux inscrits sur la liste complémentaire pour les élections municipales pouvaient participer à cette votation. »

sources.name: paris.fr — Plus ou moins de SUV ? Résultats de la votation du 4 février 2024

notes: Five arrondissements asked an extra local question the same day (see localQuestions), which may have raised turnout there.

paris_streets_2025.voteName: Votation du 23 mars 2025 — végétaliser et rendre piétonnes 500 nouvelles rues
paris_streets_2025.titleEn: Paris citizens' vote on greening and pedestrianising 500 more streets
paris_streets_2025.question: Pour ou contre végétaliser et rendre piétonnes 500 nouvelles rues dans Paris, réparties dans tous les quartiers ?
paris_streets_2025.yesMeaning: 'Pour' = speed up greening and pedestrianising 500 streets (5 to 8 per neighbourhood, within ~300 m of voters' homes), chosen with residents from April 2025, about 3 years of works.
paris_streets_2025.legalStatus: Consultative vote under the control of an independent control commission (third Paris votation).

eligibility.who: People registered on the Paris electoral lists by 26 February 2025, including EU nationals on the municipal complementary list and, for the first time, French or EU nationals aged 16 and 17.
eligibility.note: Nine EU citizens registered only on the European complementary list were allowed to vote after a decision of the commission; it suggested opening future votations to that list too.

sources.name: Rapport de la commission de contrôle, votation du 23 mars 2025 (PDF, juin 2025)

notes: Seven arrondissements asked an extra local question the same day.

Rapport de la commission de contrôle, votation du 23 mars 2025 (PDF, juin 2025)

rules.timeline: Street identification with residents from April 2025, about three years of works
rules.context: Since 2020: more than 10,000 outdoor parking spaces removed and 197 streets greened (paris.fr).
